title: Katharine the shrew illfavoured? Hortensio calls her young and beautiful.
html_source:
Another reference to http://lit.genius.com/William-shakespeare-taming-of-the-shrew-act-1-scene-2-annotated .

Hortensio refers to Katharine (the shrew) as ‘intolerable curst / And shrewd and forward’ when telling his friend Petruchio he can get him a wife.

It also has echoes of Ignatius Gallagher’s boast to Little Chandler – ‘You don’t believe it ? Well, I know it. There are hundreds, what am I saying? – thousands of rich germans and Jews, rotten with money, that’d only be too glad…’

A Little Cloud, Dubliners, James Joyce .
